data.long_meaning: Monirul is derived from the Sanskrit words 'moon' (mooni) and 'protector' (rul). This name is associated with the Hindu god Chandra, the deity of the moon. The name Monirul carries the meaning “Protector of the Moon” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Parents who choose Monirul usually hope their child will grow to embody protector of the moon and live with faith, good character and purpose.
